prompt:
Create one highest-quality, polished native Flutter mobile app screen mockup for a Chinese commercial personal bookkeeping app named 好好记账. It is a single flat portrait screenshot, approximately 393 x 852 logical pixels, rendered at high resolution, no phone bezel, no perspective, no poster framing or annotations. Exact readable Chinese text, meticulous realistic spacing.

Use the attached existing app screenshot ONLY as reference for its established 好好绿 identity: warm creamy background #FBFCF7, muted leaf green #76A33A, dark text #1E241C, thin gray-green separators, soft white surfaces, gently rounded corners, consistent thin outline icons. Keep bottom navigation labels 首页, 流水, central circular green plus button, 洞察, 我的 with 我的 active. Redesign content structure completely and do not reproduce old promotional modules.

Composition candidate B: LIGHTWEIGHT FAVORITES. A notably airy, compact tools-first layout with a small account header and no dashboard statistics, no separate runtime status card.
Top title 我的, message outline icon and settings gear at right.
A compact horizontal avatar and identity area: circular avatar 陈, name 小陈, smaller 账号中心 ›, a separate subdued compact ledger picker row 生活账本 ›.
Dominant focal section immediately beneath is 常用功能, with 全部功能 › at right. Six shortcuts in a large airy unframed 3-column by 2-row grid with thin green icons above exact labels: 我的账本, 账户资产, 自动记账, 账单导入, 预算管理, 分类管理. Icons do not have individual colored boxes or card borders. Clear comfortable tap targets. This tool grid should visibly dominate the opening viewport.
Below, a slim restrained pale-gold horizontal membership strip: small crown icon, 会员中心, subtitle 查看权益与购买记录, chevron. Keep its height modest, not a large marketing banner.
Then a section 管理与服务 made of four clean navigable list rows on one plain white surface, separated by thin rules:
账本管理, subtitle 个人账本 · 共享成员;
备份与数据, subtitle 云备份 · 本地备份 · 导入导出;
安全与隐私, subtitle 应用锁 · 权限设置;
帮助与反馈, subtitle 使用说明 · 我的工单.
Rows have consistent outline icons and right chevrons.
Leave calm breathing space above the established translucent white rounded bottom dock. No clouds or decorative artwork. Avoid the giant typography and dense stacked status cards of a status-focused layout. Native, readable commercial UI. No points, levels, unrelated app recommendations, debug controls, internal documentation, charts, fake prices or testimonials.
